# A bicycle maintenance log

Record when the chain was cleaned, tyres inspected and unusual noises noticed. Short observations are more useful than a vague annual reminder to check everything. Keep the model of replacement parts so the next purchase does not depend on memory.

An unfamiliar braking or steering problem deserves inspection by someone qualified rather than experimental adjustments on a ride. The log supports regular maintenance but is not a repair manual. A small checklist before leaving can reveal an obvious issue while tools are still nearby.
